text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: At a shrine bustling with New Year's visitors, I spotted a group of Horse Girls.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Did everyone draw their omikuji?
Don't open them yet, we're doing it all together on three, okay!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Phew... I wonder what it says...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: By the time New Year's ends, you've usually forgotten what was written anyway.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, worrying too much isn't good either. As long as it gives us a spark to spend this whole year brightly, wouldn't that be nice?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuu... I'm wicked nervous... What if I get a bad result...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Since we're all here, let's turn this into a little game!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: How about whoever draws the worst fortune gets treated to food by everyone else? Think of it as reverse ultra luck!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh, in that case, even if the result is bad, it'd still be pretty awesome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that sounds delightful, desu wa. Now then, let us reveal our fortunes...!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ready, set... GO!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My goodness! It is "Great Blessing" (Daikichi), desu wa...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: For real?! I got "Great Blessing" too!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh...?! R-Rice got "Great Blessing" too...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Quite generous of them. Mine's "Great Blessing" as well.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOAH! You wouldn't even see this in a drama! I got "Great Blessing" too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I got "Great Blessing" too... Could something like this really happen?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... maybe to bring happiness to everyone in the new year, it only gives "Great Blessing"—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...No way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: A-At least it is "Middle Blessing" or "Future Blessing", right, desu wa?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...It was... "Great Curse" (Kyou), was it not, desu wa...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: As expected of the girl aiming to be number one in Japan, Spe! You sure know your comedy! Bravo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuuuu...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: C'mon, you got the first laugh of the year, so let's hit the food stalls! Getting treated by everyone means you're holding the greatest luck of all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, I saw Special Week looking completely overjoyed with both hands full of food.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was the start of a new year that reminded me just how much the presence of friends and trainers serves as support for a Horse Girl.
